description:
ONLINE INSURANCE LINK: https://enerzy.ai/solar-insurance?rcode=SED

Online solar system insurance - estimate - documents required - online insurance policy - oriental insurance 

Solar Insurance for all On-Grid Rooftop Solar plants
All systems installed in the last 3 years
From Rs. 50,000 to Rs. 1 crore.
On-Grid, Off-Grid, and Hybrid
Risk Covers include:
Solar panels uprooting due to high-speed winds.
Theft / Burglary
Fire (any reason)
Damage to the Solar system due to external physical objects such as animals, falling trees, etc.
Storm, Tempest, Inundation, Flood, Earthquake, Terrorism, etc
Includes Remote maintenance consultancy
Claims are processed by Oriental Insurance directly


Solar Installers can also create a login on our platform and offer Solar Insurance in their product offering for their existing and new customers.
